rest: back-to-back = previous game exactly one calendar day earlier; fitted, not assumed
training_window: all scored seasons strictly before the target season, at most the previous two, never before 2022-23
home_advantage: mean home margin of the previous two seasons (or the one available), never the target season
winner_model: logistic on [elo_gap_mov/100, b2b_home, b2b_away, 1], ridge toward [0.576, 0, 0, 0.37], l2 0.002, refit per target season
team_points_model: v1 mean + ridge shift on [b2b_own, b2b_opp, 1] fitted on the training window; sd and covariance from the training window residuals; no logistic recalibration
player_calibration: v1 logistic slope/bias refit per target season on the training window
player_weight_selection: minimum mean Brier over the six player markets in the selection season only, ties to the smaller weight; test seasons never used
reference_lines: unchanged: floor(last10 mean)+0.5; no bookmaker inputs
references: v1 sealed: fixed 2022-23 calibration, RUN071 parameters
v1 raw probabilities with walk-forward logistic recalibration
metrics: paired Brier difference vs v1 sealed
confidence: paired bootstrap resampling whole dates, 400 replicates, seed 20261021
promotion: none; retrospective, seasons already inspected for v1, exploratory only
not_modeled: opponent, pace, home/away and teammates for players
